Amend recommended P01’s added willingness requirement: the printed native card says Ally, not willing. No additional consent or save gate is imposed, so an actual unconscious ally can receive this benign benefit; this does not imply unconscious consent for another spell or force allegiance. Already dead target gains no revival. Core Instantaneous remains verbatim as a source conflict; printed minute governs the authored continuing effect.

Same-spell component bonus is at most+4 per ability, irrespective of multiple records; strongest same-name wins while every record keeps independent duration/suppression. No advancement20cap is silently imported; an actual explicit absolute cap retains its own scope. Floor((score−10)/2) is the resulting ordinary modifier. No changes to INT,WIS,CHA, proficiency, classes or armor permissions.
